ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)

   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)

   A. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.

   C. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

15. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   B. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
